item.text:
### (a) Three posts

1. We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. We demand a legally binding prohibition on its development. No company or government has the right to gamble with humanity’s existence.

2. We cannot afford to lose this fight: superintelligence built with anything like current techniques will kill everyone on Earth. We are organising for a legally binding prohibition on its development. Our future must not be someone else’s experiment.

3. We reject the race to build superintelligence. With anything like current techniques, the outcome will be the death of everyone on Earth. We demand enforceable law that stops this race—not voluntary promises from the organisations driving it.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 110 words

We believe that if anyone builds superintelligence with anything like current techniques, everyone on Earth will die. That is why we are fighting for a legally binding prohibition on its development. We will not accept humanity’s extinction as the price of technological ambition, corporate competition, or national prestige. No one knows how to build these systems safely, and promises of future breakthroughs do not justify building them now. We need enforceable law, not voluntary commitments that developers can abandon when convenient. Our task is clear: build the public pressure and political resolve to stop this race. Together, we can defend the future that every person on Earth stands to lose.
